notes.title: Major progress in 2024 and getting ready for an exciting 2025
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

I'm Rhomita, the developer of Notmads.

I'm thrilled as 2024 comes to an end because it has been an incredible year for Notmads. I've made significant progress, staying on schedule and meeting expectations. Plus, I've started working with a talented artist who's creating new 3D models to replace the current ones.

Thanks to this progress, I'm estimating a release date for Q4 2025. This will be an Early Access (Alpha) version, featuring many core mechanics and final 3D models for key elements like characters and the beast. This version won’t include the full story, just the opening moments—likely limited to a single island—but the full story and additional islands will be added during the development of the final version, available through regular updates. As development progresses, I'll also update other 3D models as they’re completed.

Additionally, this version will include a completely revamped UI, very different from the current pre-alpha version, and full controller support.

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and follow the page if you’re interested! And if you want to play the pre-alpha version now and support the project, you can do so through [url=https://www.patreon.com/notmads]Patreon[/url].

Happy holidays, and here's to a great start to 2025!

Cheers,
Rhomita

notes.title: New Pre-Alpha version 0.1.0 is now available ✨
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's me, Rhomita, the developer of [b]Notmads[/b].
I'm really happy because after a few months of development, I've released a new Pre-Alpha version. 
This update contains lots of new features, fixes, and a completely new island to explore (which will be the starter island in the final game). 
I've also migrated the game to a new Unreal Engine version; it was using version 4, and now it's using Unreal Engine 5! It took some time because there are big differences, but I'll be able to speed up development by using all the new features of the engine.

In addition to this, I've released my first devblog on YouTube, where I explain a bit more about what the game is about. Please check it out! 👇

[previewyoutube=Is4H3__byDQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to show your support and get early access to this pre-alpha version, you might want to check out [url=https://www.patreon.com/Notmads]Notmads' Patreon[/url]. Remember, it's optional, but your contribution really helps make Notmads even better!

Thanks so much for your interest in Notmads! Excited to share more updates with you soon!

[url=https://notmads.com/]Notmads[/url]

notes.title: Notmads: A look back at 2023, What's next in 2024!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'm [b]Rhomita, the creator of Notmads[/b], and I wanted to share how awesome 2023 has been for the game's development. Throughout the year, the pre-alpha version has seen numerous updates, introducing fantastic features. Exciting news: a major update with new core mechanics is on the horizon, likely arriving in January.

On top of that, I had the pleasure of showcasing Notmads at two indie game development events. The response was fantastic – players enjoyed the game, and the feedback was overwhelmingly positive!

Looking ahead to 2024, I'm committed to putting in the hard work to bring Notmads to the next level. It's a crucial year as I aim to finalize things and announce the Alpha Early Access release date. I've got an estimated date in mind, but I want to ensure everything is solid before making it official.

If you're interested in showing your support and getting early access to the pre-alpha, you might want to consider checking out [url=https://www.patreon.com/notmads]Notmads' Patreon[/url]. Remember, it's entirely optional, but your contribution goes a long way in making Notmads even better!

Thanks a lot for being interested in Notmads! Can't wait to share more updates with you soon!

notes.title: Notmads development update
notes.notes:
Hello there! 
I'm [b]Rhomita, the developer of Notmads[/b], and I'm thrilled to update you on the progress I've made during the first 4 months of the year. I've been working tirelessly over the past few months to implement new features and mechanics, and I'm excited to share that I've made significant strides forward.

Since the initial release of version [b]0.0.1 on January 1st 2023[/b], I've been able to push out several updates and improvements, reaching version [b]0.0.30[/b]. Some of the highlights include the implementation of "[i]quick inventory slots[/i]" which allows players to quickly access their inventory to consume items faster by assigning them to four available slots. Additionally, one of the last updates introduces 14 new passive skills to increase defence and attack, as well as 40 new potions and several new active skills such as "Explosion", "Thunderstorm", among others. It also includes various improvements to the game's beast mechanics, increased skill slots, and enhanced AI behaviour for both beasts and enemies. Moreover, several bug fixes and improvements have been made to the game's performance and UI/UX.

Please note that [b]Notmads[/b] is currently in a closed pre-alpha state, and while early access is not yet available, I will update you on the release date as soon as it's defined. 
If you're interested in supporting me and [b]gaining access to the pre-alpha[/b], you can do so through [url=https://www.patreon.com/notmads]Patreon[/url], but this is entirely optional.

Thank you very much for your interest in Notmads, and I look forward to sharing more updates with you soon!
